events.title: BlackBerry Pearl released
events.summary: BlackBerry released the BlackBerry Pearl — consumer-focused BlackBerry with trackball and camera.
events.about: BlackBerry dominated enterprise mobile before iPhone and Android. Consumer-focused blackberry with trackball and camera. BES-connected apps and push email defined mobile workflows for years.

narrative.whyChosen: The BlackBerry Pearl was a key BlackBerry hardware milestone.
narrative.whyImportant: BlackBerry hardware set expectations for mobile email and messaging security.
narrative.problemSolved: Business users needed secure mobile email before modern smartphone platforms.
